proof: For first-machine jobs with chosen-last-duration plus minimum-middle sum >=Q, their first operations finish byT-Q. Their disjoint processing therefore sums to <=T-Q. For last-machine jobs with chosen-first-duration plus minimum-middle sum >=H, their last operations start >=H, so disjoint last-processing sums to <=T-H. Each job chooses one original first/last mode pair. Any original feasible schedule embeds in these rows.
